label: sec:substrate-parameter-preamble
html: This section promotes the substrate parameter q from an algebraic device to a structural ingredient of the categorical deformation. It extracts q from the categorical braiding, identifying it as the eigenvalue governing the symmetric tensor channel. This links the microscopic categorical data directly to the macroscopic fluid parameter. It then establishes the \mathbb{G}_m-family of differentials and the categorical gauge group deformation from \mathrm{SU}(2) to \mathrm{SU}_q(2).
